notes.title: Tenderizing The Meat
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410037/918e97c7a4fc757552e9d39b727d3934d9df4400.png[/img]

Hi all,

Hope you're having fun out there.

We're excited to put our next Devlog video for "Chop Sous-Y-Chef" up on Steam!

We've made a bunch of core feature progress, particularly in the realm of character animations, enemy AI extensions and features for attacks and weapons (this devlog focuses a bit more on samples of unarmed and melee weapon combat).

As always dont be a stranger and we'll be back before you know it with another update.

Til then all the best,
IS Team

notes.title: Merely An Amuse-Bouche
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45410037/e8c573cc358e6f017a7c2550753e273efdcb0312.png[/img]

Hi folks,

Hope you're having fun out there.

We're excited to put our first Devlog video for "Chop Sous-Y-Chef" up on Steam!

It's obviously still early days for the game, but the base mechanics and features build out is progressing well.

We also have some exciting news about the game that we'll be announcing soon to all reputable outlets. :)

In the meantime dont be a stranger, feel free to wishlist the game and we'll be back before you know it with another update.

Til then all the best,
IS Team
